title: Army Claims Dozens of RSF Fighters Killed in Nyala Attack; RSF Reports Market Strike
detail: Al Jazeera reported the Sudanese army claimed dozens of RSF fighters were killed in an attack on Nyala, South Darfur. The RSF said an army drone attack hit a busy livestock market in the city, killing 30 civilians; the claims are unverified. Army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan vowed to retake 'every inch' of RSF-held territory. The strikes preceded the Oct 18-19 drone wave across Khartoum, Al-Dibab and Nyala.

media.caption: Sudan's army claims dozens of RSF fighters killed in Nyala attack
